feeds.title: The Classics Club
feeds.description: The Classics Club was started on March 7, 2012, with a goal to unite those of us who like to blog about classic literature, as well as to inspire people to make the classics an integral part of life.

feeds.title: Tea and Ink Society Blog
feeds.description: I'm Elsie! I believe that the right books can capture your heart and allow you to live life with a sense of wonder. This site will help you discover those books, and give you a community of kindred spirits who love reading as much as you do.

feeds.title: A Year of Reading The World
feeds.description: Ann Morgan, a UK-based author, TED speaker, Royal Literary Fund fellow, and editor, is best known for her first book, 'Reading the World' (or 'The World Between Two Covers' in the US). This work was inspired by her year-long journey through a book from every country in the world, a remarkable adventure documented on her blog. In addition to her non-fiction work, Ann is the author of two novels: 'Beside Myself' and 'Crossing Over.'

feeds.title: Tredynas Days
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Simon Lavery. I've written and read for as long as I can remember, and that's why I started this blog: I wanted to share that passion. I sit with my grandchildren, writing their stories with them and for stories myself because I believe it's through our stories that we connect with each other.

feeds.title: In Search of the Classic Mystery Novel Blog
feeds.description: I've read detective fiction since very young, starting with the Famous Five and progressing to the proper stuff. I've got very eclectic tastes in the mystery genre and here you will find a spoiler-free review of fair play detective fiction.

feeds.title: anenduringromantic
feeds.description: Hi & welcome. I'm Gautam Bhatia and I hope you find something that interests you. This is a blog where I post my thoughts on what I read - literature and poetry of any and all kinds, anything that I can lay my hands on, and everything that I find interesting.

feeds.title: Classical Carousel
feeds.description: Read Classical Carousel's journey through the classics on this blog. The blog aims to provide you with major literary works of renowned artists & writers. Find articles that talk about classic novels, poetry, translations, drama, and more.

feeds.title: Canterbury Classics » Classic Literature
feeds.description: Canterbury Classics publishes classic works of literature in fresh, modern formats. Whether you want to reread a classic or introduce a loved one to a timeless tale, Canterbury Classics gives old-school literature a new lease on life with modern covers, custom endpapers, and colourful leather binding. Both fiction and nonfiction works receive modern makeovers, earning their place on any colour-coded bookshelf.

feeds.title: Esther Racah
feeds.description: A literary blog with reviews about some of my favorite books. A dreaming place where you can find my own poetry. I am an Italian-Israeli literary blogger and poet. I have a PhD in Physics, and I am a former researcher in Astroparticle Physics. Previously, I had studied Ancient Greek and Latin. Books, literature, poetry, and art are some of my passions.

feeds.title: The Enchanted Book Club Blog
feeds.description: The Enchanted Book Club blog shares short reflections and updates for readers who love classic literature, featuring posts about timeless books, literary inspiration, and community events.

feeds.title: Thornfield Hall Blog
feeds.description: Thornfield Hall Blog explores classic literature, especially Victorian and early 20th-century works, offering analyses of themes, characters, and storytelling. It connects these classics to modern relevance while examining their cultural and historical contexts, creating thoughtful literary discussions.

feeds.title: Compulsive Reader » Classic Literature
feeds.description: Reviews of books by some of the hottest writers working today, exclusive author interviews, literary news and criticism. Compulsive Reader's Classic Literature Reviews section is a blog category where the author publishes thoughtful, in-depth reviews of classic works.

feeds.title: Ancient Literature » Blog
feeds.description: We want to make sure the world is treated to the important lessons offered by world history, and also, engage people by introducing them to the importance and beauty of cultural heritage. We seek to provide those interested with some of the most famous quotes, stories and texts so that they can learn and apply them to their own lives. Our goal is to make sure that we bring to the surface all forms of classical literature.

feeds.title: Literary Forge Blog
feeds.description: Literary Forge is a blog and discussion forum for discussing great books and great ideas. The blog is written by the author Tommy Collison.

feeds.title: reading classics Blog
feeds.description: Lea Reads Classics is a personal literature blog where Lea shares her thoughts on classic books, reading experiences, and literary themes. The author studies English Literature in London.

feeds.title: On Book Street Blog » Classics
feeds.description: On Book Street's Classics blog is part of a cozy, book-lover site that sells printables, journals, and reading gifts. The blog section dives into classic literature with thoughtful posts and reading inspiration. The site is run by 'Jennifer,' a former book blogger who now operates the shop and blog.

feeds.title: A Fondness For Reading » Classics
feeds.description: The Classics section of A Fondness for Reading features Robin's reflections and reviews on classic literature, including her participation in challenges like the Classics Club Spin. She writes about well-known authors such as Jane Austen, revisits favorite classics, and shares how her perspective on these books evolves over time, blending personal reading experiences with thoughtful commentary on timeless works.

feeds.title: Classical Pursuits
feeds.description: Would you like to retreat for a while from the hurly-burly of daily life to throw yourself into a good book, great art, or fine music? Come spend some time with us. Classical Pursuits offers three distinct but complementary options: Toronto Pursuits, Travel Pursuits and Made to Measure trip planning.
